name: @qu/sync
description: Peer-to-peer replication: subscribe to paths, get notified when peers write, request/response fetch for data you don't have yet. Persistent outbox (survives a reload while offline) and reconnect catch-up (fetchPrefix) are both built in. SyncEngine applies @qu/engines' assertWriteAuthorized() to every incoming synced write - the V3 fix for the confirmed ACL-bypass-on-sync gap (docs/v3-technical-concept.md §3.3).
